sections.heading: Excerpt
sections.text: Finally, the index page for the blog theme, is working. Posts' headers look nice. However, at this point, the whole code is... spaguetti code. KB4IT needs a big overhaul.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: Builder module works fine when the source files (.adoc files) are analyzed first. But other pages, like the index page, which are build at the end, do not follow the standard process.
